spiritgiven.comments: Great communication and loved how both teams keep the calls within the time limit.

- Good communications between both teams in terms on the several check-ins to ensure the calls are not affecting the teams' spirit
- Both teams agreed to minimize body contacts and agreed on the physicality level however we feel there's still not much improvement received from the other team. We've highlighted this to them and the feedback was well noted for the upcoming games.

Loved the attitude and energy given from France for the constant cheering and high-fives for their opponent. They are always open to listen to our opinion first during calls and are very in control to discuss any calls happened on the field
Really great game! There were a few discussions held during the game but all were resolved pretty fairly and quickly
Really great game! We loved the energy and intensity throughout the whole game. Despite the scores, they have been cheering and constantly high-fiving us be it during highs or lows.

- We've feedback to the spirit captain regarding the body contacts however we think there might be a miscommunication as the message wasn't delivered to the players and there was maybe very less attempt to avoid contacts between players.
- We've also highlighted regarding the fast counts that was called after the stall-out call which we think it needs to be called earlier.
- Glad that both team have clarified regarding the pick calls between handlers movement
great communication between both teams and we really appreciate the friendliness and cheerfulness on and off the field.

- amazing communication and friendliness between both team
- we did felt there were abit more body contacts throughout the whole tournament after the feedback but calls were resolved fairly quick.

spiritreceived.comments: They were very receptive to calls and heed our opinion.

Thanks for the game! 

In general, we appreciated the communication between our two teams which are relatively new to WUC, especially the post-game spirit captain debrief. Happy to see we are on the same page to keep trying to adjust and decrease physicality. It seems like both teams felt like physicality did not decrease despite communication and we can both work on that.

We also appreciated the fair mindedness in a few calls, but also felt that some calls took too long to resolve.
Generally very well spirited game, nothing out of the ordinary. Thankful for constant check-ins from spirit captains!
We loved your smiles, joyful and very active sideline, as well as your great communication, especially on the gender mismatch and between points to check if everything was right on both sides.

It was an intense game with a lot of physical contact. We appreciate the efficient discussion on-field and the frequent check-ins on spirit and contact. While we sensed the improvement in body contact in the second half, we feel there is still more room for improvement but appreciated the game nonetheless.

For contact we gave 2 but was on the lower side of 2. 
Communication was great and that’s why we gave it a 3
